description: CLOSED asset-role registry. Every media-bearing field in schema/pagespec.schema.json references `roleEnum` — there is no bare `image`/`src` string anywhere in the schema, so a generator cannot invent asset semantics.
sourceSite: https://www.arrakis.tech/ — a REAL, LIVE company website. Everything below follows from that fact and is a compliance constraint, not a style preference.

pinnedPolicies._why: MASTER-GUIDE §3.23: membership-in-a-closed-set is a weaker claim than 'this specific role is pinned to this specific value'. These 8 roles carry real legal weight (a live company's trademark, third-party trademarks, audited compliance marks, commercially licensed typefaces, opaque binaries that cannot be regenerated). extraction/verify_all.py asserts each role's generationPolicy EQUALS the value below, so changing one to a different-but-still-valid enum member fails the run.

brand.logo-primary.description: The Arrakis wordmark (inline SVG path in Header.jsx) and the icon-only mark (Footer.jsx).
brand.logo-primary.aiGuidance: A generated page MUST NOT reproduce this mark, its path data, or any mark styled to be mistaken for it. Substitute a clearly-placeholder wordmark for the page being generated.

brand.favicon.description: public/favicons/* and public/favicon.ico — the real company's favicon set and web manifest.
brand.favicon.aiGuidance: MUST NOT be reused. Generate or omit.

brand.partner-logo.description: Third-party product/vendor trademarks shown as integration targets in industry.logo-showcase (4 tabs x 4-6 logos) and in integrations.paginated-panels.
brand.partner-logo.aiGuidance: A generated page MUST NOT reproduce any of these trademarks, and MUST NOT assert an integration or partnership that the page's own subject does not actually have. Use neutral placeholder tiles.

brand.press-logo.description: Publication mastheads in social.press-banner, each linked to a real article about the real company.
brand.press-logo.aiGuidance: MUST NOT be reproduced, and a press banner MUST NOT be generated with fabricated coverage or fabricated article URLs. Omit the section rather than invent press.

brand.investor-logo.description: Backer/customer marks in the hero logo banner (7 logos cycled through 5 slots).
brand.investor-logo.aiGuidance: MUST NOT be reproduced, and investor/customer logos MUST NOT be fabricated. Omit the row rather than invent backers.

compliance.badge.aiGuidance: A compliance badge asserts an audited, verifiable fact about a real organisation. A generated page MUST NOT emit one unless the fact is supplied and verified by the operator. Never generate a certification mark to fill a slot.

illustration.feature-icon.description: Abstract 40x40 stroke icons for shared.icon-grid and the industry icon-slider. 11 distinct files; light and dark variants are DISTINCT files, not CSS recolours.
illustration.feature-icon.aiGuidance: Safe to generate new. Match: 40x40 viewBox, 1px-equivalent stroke, no fill, monochrome via currentColor, geometric/abstract — no logos, no literal objects, no text.

illustration.value-scene.description: Four 205x180 abstract SVG scenes for about.sticky-aside-list.
illustration.value-scene.aiGuidance: Safe to generate new. Match: 205x180, flat, warm neutral palette drawn from {color.dust}/{color.sand}/{color.stroke-1}, no photography, no people.

illustration.industry-masthead.description: Five 517x345 abstract industry SVGs for industry.nav-masthead on the non-shipping routes.
illustration.industry-masthead.aiGuidance: Safe to generate new at 517x345. Must stay abstract/diagrammatic — no recognisable real vessels, aircraft, plants or facilities that could read as a real customer's property.

media.product-screenshot.description: Raster captures of the real product UI (dashboard, governance console). Source HEIFs transcoded to WebP because HEIF does not decode in browsers.
media.product-screenshot.aiGuidance: MUST NOT be fabricated: a synthesised product screenshot is a false claim about what the software does. Either reuse the exact file in a like-for-like clone, or omit the media and keep the layout's intrinsic ratio with a neutral placeholder. The intrinsic width/height is load-bearing — it sets the section height, there is no aspect-ratio wrapper.

media.hero-video.description: Five .webm clips in the hero's 8000ms rotation.
media.hero-video.aiGuidance: MUST NOT be fabricated. Reuse exact or omit; the hero degrades to the caption-only state.

motion.rive-scene.description: 11 .riv binaries rendered to WebGL canvases by @rive-app/webgl2.
motion.rive-scene.aiGuidance: A .riv is an opaque compiled binary with named state machines and inputs. It CANNOT be generated or edited from text. Reuse exact, or substitute a static image and set the wrapper's aspect-ratio explicitly.

decoration.texture.aiGuidance: Safe to generate new. Keep them aria-hidden and pointer-events-none as the real source does.

typeface.webfont.description: terraneSerif (300, 400), terraneSans (300, 400), pxGrotesk (400) — five self-hosted .woff2 files in public/assets/fonts/.
typeface.webfont.licensing: ALL THREE TYPEFACES ARE COMMERCIALLY LICENSED. They are self-hosted in the clone for fidelity only; they are NOT redistributable and no licence for them ships with this design-repo. A derived or generated project MUST either hold its own licence or substitute. The @font-face blocks ship metric-override fallback families ('<name> Fallback', src: local('Arial') with ascent/descent/line-gap/size-adjust overrides) so the layout does not shift between the fallback and the webfont paint — substituting is therefore low-risk.
typeface.webfont.aiGuidance: MUST NOT be redistributed. A generated or derived project either holds its own licence for these three families or substitutes. Substitution is low-risk here because the real @font-face blocks ship metric-override fallback families, so the layout does not shift. Never copy the .woff2 files into a new deliverable and never reference them from a public URL.

nonAssetContentBans._why: Not every reproduction risk is an image. These are the non-asset strings a generated page must not carry over.

realContactEmails.note: Real, live mailboxes. A generated page MUST NOT send traffic to them.

realLegalText.description: /terms-of-service and /cookie-policy reproduce the REAL company's real legal text verbatim (src/data/legal-terms.js, src/data/legal-cookie.js — 24 and 8 blocks). This is another organisation's legal instrument and is also factually wrong for any other operator.
realLegalText.aiGuidance: The legal template's STRUCTURE is reusable. Its TEXT must be replaced wholesale, never reused or paraphrased. The template contract therefore sets `content.requiresOperatorSuppliedText: true`.

realCompanyCopy.description: Every heading, lede and stat in src/data/* is a real company's real claim (e.g. '8+ Countries Arrakis is live in', '100+ Agents in production', '6x Agent performance uplift on Arrakis Harness').
realCompanyCopy.aiGuidance: Copy budgets (maxWords) and tone are reusable. The claims are not. A generated page must not carry a stat, customer count or outcome figure over from this design-repo.
